admissionRule: Each technique requires generated 9:16, 3:4, 16:9, and 4:3 assets, thumbnail review, and human approval on another real project before promotion.

records.title: 真人原片铺满，内容优先于品牌框
records.definition: 有可靠真人素材时使用真实视频帧作为全画面背景，不显示固定品牌 badge，让标题层级和高对比语法承担跨期一致性；标题可以遮挡人物。

evidence.observation: Face, headline, and contrast hierarchy remain readable while the real background changes.
The user rejected brand-heavy and decorative alternatives, required a real-person background, and accepted oversized copy even when it covers the face.

prohibitions: force a brand badge onto every episode
prioritize an unobstructed face over headline readability

records.title: 第一行认知冲突，第二行后果或结果
records.definition: 封面最多两行超大标题：第一行打破观众默认认知，第二行给出损失、后果或可见结果；功能说明和完整叙述移到发布标题与正文。

evidence.observation: High-contrast two-line questions and consequences dominate before secondary detail.
The conflict title 收藏≠学会 / 越存越没用 was preferred over the descriptive feature title 几千条收藏 / AI秒找回.

prohibitions: shrink long feature descriptions to fit
use a category label as the only click reason

records.title: 四画幅独立排版与版本化交付
records.definition: 分别为 9:16、3:4、16:9、4:3 计算背景裁切、标题字号、位置和安全区，并为每轮候选使用新的版本化文件名，避免简单裁切、拉伸和客户端缓存误判。

evidence.observation: The profile grid judges a different composition boundary from the full video frame.
The user required a 4:3 landscape asset and same-path overwrites caused visually stale review results.

prohibitions: place essential text outside the ratio-specific safe area
